'''Cheryl Kallenbach''' is named on the fan anagram list as the unscrambling of [[Chyler]]. The same list treats [[Chall Bekan]] and Imperial Helmsman (Bachenhall) as Kallenbach family names.

== Anagrams ==

* [[Chyler]] — Cheryl Kallenbach

== Other sourced notes ==

No independent Decipher staff title for Cheryl was located this pass beyond the anagram relation. Do not invent a job.

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Kallenbach playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
